dedupe_keys.name: ogc sensorthings api part 1 sensing 1 1 part 2 tasking and extensions

description: The OGC SensorThings API is an open standard that defines RESTful interfaces for connecting internet-of-things sensors, their observations and metadata, and is widely used by city, water and environmental monitoring platforms to publish live sensor feeds. Part 1 Sensing version 1.1 (document 18-088, editors S. Liang, T. Khalafbeigi and H. van der Schaaf; approved 26 November 2020, published 4 August 2021) is mostly backwards compatible with version 1.0 (15-078r6). Coverage: the data model has eight entities, Thing, Location, HistoricalLocation, Datastream, Sensor, ObservedProperty, Observation and FeatureOfInterest, mapped to ISO/OGC Observations and Measurements; the service follows OASIS OData conventions for filtering, and extensions cover create-update-delete, batch requests, multi-datastreams, data arrays and MQTT publish and subscribe. Version 1.1 adds a free-form properties field to almost every entity. Related OGC documents are Part 2 Tasking Core (17-079r1), the STAplus extension (22-022r1) and a WebSub extension (24-032r1). Format and access: HTML standards on docs.ogc.org; implementations expose JSON over HTTP and MQTT, often at a path such as /FROST-Server/v1.1; free. Licence: OGC copyright with the OGC licence agreement allowing free implementation, copying and redistribution with notices kept. Caveats: this is an interface standard, not a dataset; the endpoints that use it are separate resources and were not listed here. Simulation uses: a uniform way to pull live sensor streams into digital twins and emergency response dashboards. Related records: the OGC WaterML 2 standards (data-ogc-waterml-2) and FIWARE smart data models (data-fiware-smart-data-models-streetlighting) are neighbouring observation and IoT data models.
